title: Home Mortgage Loans: which programs allow a recast, the curtailment needed and the recast fee
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: which programs allow a recast, the curtailment needed and the recast fee

A recast re-amortizes the monthly payment after a large extra principal payment (a curtailment). This document states, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, whether a recast is allowed, the total of curtailments since the last recast that a recast needs, and the fee for a recast.

## Terms by program

| Program | Recast allowed | Curtailments since the last recast needed for a recast (USD) | Recast fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Yes | 10000.00 | 250.00 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | Yes | 10000.00 | 250.00 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Yes | 50000.00 | 500.00 |

"Not applicable" means the program sets no curtailment total and no fee, which follows from the program not allowing a recast.

## Comparison of the three programs that allow a recast

| Program | Curtailments needed | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 10000.00 | 250.00 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 10000.00 | 250.00 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 500.00 |

## Basis Q&A

- **Hypothetical case.** Curtailments of 12000.00 since the last recast on a Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan exceed the 10000.00 figure for that program; the same 12000.00 on a Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage loan falls short of the 50000.00 figure.
- **Does the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage allow a recast?** No; its recast allowance is "No".
